mechanism: Nalmefene is metabolized by CYP3A4 and cyclosporine is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor, potentially increasing nalmefene concentrations; additionally, both drugs can affect hepatic function and renal perfusion.
action: Monitor for increased nalmefene effects (opioid antagonism) and consider dose adjustment of nalmefene if co-administered; ensure adequate hepatic and renal function monitoring.
